The rest act on the\nblock tree returned by `parse_lines` and on the exact stdout bytes, which is the state handed back.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser.blocks import PARAGRAPH, SETEXT_HEADING, THEMATIC_BREAK, parse_lines\n\n\ndef run_commonmark(project_root: Path, source: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=source,\n        capture_output=True,\n        text=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\ndef kinds(lines: list[str]) -> list[str]:\n    \"\"\"Names of the top-level block types that `lines` produce, in order.\"\"\"\n    return [child.kind.name for child in parse_lines(lines).children]\n\n\ndef render(project_root: Path, source: str) -> str:\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, source)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    return result.stdout\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Setext-Headings.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_setext_both_levels(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Equals underlines give h1 and dash underlines give h2.\"\"\"\n    equals = run_commonmark(project_root, \"Foo *bar*\\n=========\\n\")\n    dashes = run_commonmark(project_root, \"Foo *bar*\\n---------\\n\")\n    print(equals.stdout)\n    print(dashes.stdout)\n    assert equals.returncode == 0\n    assert dashes.returncode == 0\n    assert equals.stdout.count(\"<h1>\") == 1\n    assert dashes.stdout.count(\"<h2>\") == 1\n    assert equals.stdout.count(\"<em>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_setext_multiline_content(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Several paragraph lines before the underline become one heading with no paragraph.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"Foo\\nBar\\n---\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<h2>\") == 1\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_setext_underline_beats_thematic_break(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Dashes after paragraph text make a heading, not a thematic break.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"Foo\\n---\\nbar\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<h2>\") == 1\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<hr />\") == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_setext_sequence_with_thematic_breaks(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Dashes with no preceding paragraph are thematic breaks, mixed with two setext headings and a paragraph.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"---\\nFoo\\n---\\nBar\\n---\\nBaz\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<hr />\") == 1\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<h2>\") == 2\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_setext_underline_limits(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Four spaces of indentation or internal spaces disqualify the underline.\"\"\"\n    for source in (\"Foo\\n    ---\\n\", \"Foo\\n= =\\n\"):\n        result = run_commonmark(project_root, source)\n        print(result.stdout)\n        assert result.returncode == 0\n        assert result.stdout.count(\"<h1>\") == 0\n        assert result.stdout.count(\"<h2>\") == 0\n        assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_setext_not_lazy_in_quote(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An unmarked underline after a quote paragraph does not make a heading inside the quote.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"> foo\\nbar\\n===\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<h1>\") == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<blockquote>\") == 1\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_setext_quote_then_thematic_break(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Dashes after a quote without a marker are a thematic break outside the quote.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"> Foo\\n---\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<blockquote>\") == 1\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<hr />\") == 1\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<h2>\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_setext_empty_is_paragraph(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"An underline with no content line is not a heading.\"\"\"\n    result = run_commonmark(project_root, \"\\n====\\n\")\n    print(result.stdout)\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<h1>\") == 0\n    assert result.stdout.count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n\n# --- Block tree: underline levels and shape ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize((\"marker\", \"level\"), is SETEXT_HEADING\n    assert block.level == level\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"length\", [1, 2, 9])\ndef test_underline_of_any_length_is_a_heading(length: int) -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", \"=\" * length]) == [SETEXT_HEADING.name]\n\n\ndef test_heading_content_is_all_paragraph_lines_joined() -> None:\n    (block,) = parse_lines([\"Foo\", \"Bar\", \"---\"]).children\n    assert block.content == \"Foo\\nBar\"\n\n\ndef test_heading_content_strips_surrounding_spaces_and_tabs() -> None:\n    (block,) = parse_lines([\" \\tFoo \\t\", \"===\"]).children\n    assert block.content == test_up_to_three_spaces_before_underline(indent: int) -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", \" \" * indent + \"===\"]) == [SETEXT_HEADING.name]\n\n\ndef test_four_spaces_before_underline_is_paragraph_text() -> None:\n    (block,) = parse_lines([\"Foo\", \"    ===\"]).children\n    assert block.kind is PARAGRAPH\n    assert block.content == \"Foo\\n===\"\n\n\ndef test_internal_space_in_underline_is_paragraph_text() -> None:\n    (block,) = parse_lines([\"Foo\", \"= =\"]).children\n    assert block.kind is PARAGRAPH\n\n\ndef test_underline_with_other_characters_is_paragraph_text() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", \"=-=\"]) == [PARAGRAPH.name]\n\n\ndef test_mixed_marker_underline_is_not_setext() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", \"-=-\"]) == [PARAGRAPH.name]\n\n\n# --- Block tree: precedence over thematic break ---\n\n\ndef test_dashes_after_paragraph_are_not_a_thematic_break() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", \"---\"]) == [SETEXT_HEADING.name]\n\n\ndef test_dashes_without_paragraph_are_a_thematic_break() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"---\"]) == [THEMATIC_BREAK.name]\n\n\ndef test_asterisks_after_paragraph_are_a_thematic_break() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", \"***\"]) == [PARAGRAPH.name, THEMATIC_BREAK.name]\n\n\ndef test_underscores_after_paragraph_are_a_thematic_break() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", \"___\"]) == [PARAGRAPH.name, THEMATIC_BREAK.name]\n\n\ndef test_equals_alone_is_paragraph_text() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"====\"]) == [PARAGRAPH.name]\n\n\ndef test_empty_setext_heading_is_never_produced() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"\", \"====\"]) == [PARAGRAPH.name]\n\n\n# --- Block tree: neighbours and continuation ---\n\n\ndef test_paragraph_resumes_after_setext_heading() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", \"===\", \"bar\"]) == [SETEXT_HEADING.name, PARAGRAPH.name]\n\n\ndef test_setext_heading_followed_by_blank_line_stays_one_block() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", \"===\", \"\"]) == [SETEXT_HEADING.name]\n\n\ndef test_paragraph_before_setext_heading_is_replaced_not_kept() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", \"Bar\", \"===\"]) == [SETEXT_HEADING.name]\n\n\ndef test_second_underline_after_new_paragraph_makes_second_heading() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"Foo\", \"===\", \"Bar\", \"===\"]) == [SETEXT_HEADING.name, SETEXT_HEADING.name]\n\n\ndef test_heading_inside_quote_when_underline_is_marked() -> None:\n    (quote,) = parse_lines([\"> Foo\", \"> ===\"]).children\n    assert quote.kind.name == \"block_quote\"\n    assert [child.kind.name for child in quote.children] == [SETEXT_HEADING.name]\n\n\ndef test_link_definition_is_not_heading_text() -> None:\n    (block,) = parse_lines([\"[foo]: /url\", \"Bar\", \"===\"]).children\n    assert block.kind is SETEXT_HEADING\n    assert block.content == \"Bar\"\n\n\ndef test_link_definition_only_makes_underline_paragraph_text() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"[foo]: /url\", \"===\"]) == [PARAGRAPH.name]\n\n\ndef test_link_definition_only_with_dashes_is_a_thematic_break() -> None:\n    assert kinds([\"[foo]: /url\", \"---\"]) == [THEMATIC_BREAK.name]\n\n\n# --- Exact output through the executable ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize((\"marker\", \"level\"), [(\"=\", 1), (\"-\", 2)])\ndef test_setext_renders_exactly_at_each_level(project_root: Path, marker: str, level: int) -> Registry tests use block types defined here, which shows that\nthe loop never names a concrete type.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import blocks\nfrom mdparser.blocks import (\n    DOCUMENT,\n    PARAGRAPH,\n    Block,\n    BlockRegistry,\n    BlockType,\n    Cursor,\n    DocumentParser,\n    indent_columns,\n    next_column,\n    parse_lines,\n)\n\n\ndef kinds(block: Block) -> list[str]:\n    return [child.kind.name for child in block.children]\n\n\ndef paragraph_contents(block: Block) -> list[str]:\n    return [child.content for child in block.children if child.kind is PARAGRAPH]\n\n\n# --- Column helpers ---\n\n\ndef test_next_column_for_a_space_advances_one() -> None:\n    assert next_column(\" \", 3) == 4\n\n\ndef test_next_column_for_a_tab_advances_to_next_tab_stop() -> None:\n    assert next_column(\"\\t\", 0) == 4\n    assert next_column(\"\\t\", 2) == 4\n    assert next_column(\"\\t\", 4) == 8\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_counts_spaces() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"   x\", 0, 0) == 3\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_expands_a_leading_tab_to_four() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"\\tx\", 0, 0) == 4\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_pads_a_tab_after_spaces_to_the_tab_stop() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"  \\tx\", 0, 0) == 4\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_counts_two_tabs_as_eight() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"\\t\\tx\", 0, 0) == 8\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_is_zero_without_leading_whitespace() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"x  \", 0, 0) == 0\n\n\ndef test_indent_columns_starts_from_the_given_column() -> None:\n    assert indent_columns(\"\\tx\", 0, 2) == 2\n\n\n# --- Cursor ---\n\n\ndef test_cursor_rest_starts_as_the_whole_line() -> None:\n    assert Cursor(\"abc\").rest == \"abc\"\n\n\ndef test_cursor_is_blank_for_empty_and_whitespace_lines() -> None:\n    assert Cursor(\"\").is_blank()\n    assert Cursor(\" \\t \").is_blank()\n\n\ndef test_cursor_is_not_blank_with_text() -> None:\n    assert not Cursor(\"  a\").is_blank()\n\n\ndef test_cursor_advance_nonspace_tracks_column_across_a_tab() -> None:\n    cursor = Cursor(\"  \\t x\")\n    cursor.advance_nonspace()\n    assert cursor.pos == 4\n    assert cursor.col == 5\n    assert cursor.rest == \"x\"\n\n\ndef test_cursor_advance_columns_consumes_whole_tab_when_it_overshoots() -> None:\n    cursor = Cursor(\"\\tx\")\n    cursor.advance_columns(2)\n    assert cursor.pos == 1\n    assert cursor.col == 4\n    assert cursor.rest == \"x\"\n\n\ndef test_cursor_advance_columns_stops_at_the_target_column() -> None:\n    cursor = Cursor(\"    x\")\n    cursor.advance_columns(2)\n    assert cursor.rest == \"  x\"\n\n\ndef test_cursor_indent_reports_columns_to_next_text() -> None:\n    assert Cursor(\"\\t\\tx\").indent == 8\n\n\ndef test_cursor_advance_to_moves_by_characters() -> None:\n    cursor = Cursor(\"abc\")\n    cursor.advance_to(2)\n    assert cursor.rest == \"c\"\n\n\n# --- Empty and blank input ---\n\n\ndef test_empty_input_gives_empty_document() -> None:\n    assert parse_lines([]).children == []\n\n\ndef test_one_empty_line_gives_empty_document() -> None:\n    assert parse_lines([\"\"]).children == []\n\n\ndef test_blank_lines_only_give_empty_document() -> None:\n    assert parse_lines([\"\", \"  \", \"\\t\", \" \\t \"]).children == []\n\n\ndef test_leading_and_trailing_blank_lines_add_no_blocks() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"\", \" \", \"word\", \"\", \"\\t\", \"\"])\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"paragraph\"]\n    assert paragraph_contents(root) == [\"word\"]\n\n\n# --- Paragraphs ---\n\n\ndef test_single_line_makes_one_paragraph() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"hello\"])\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"paragraph\"]\n    assert paragraph_contents(root) == [\"hello\"]\n\n\ndef test_blank_line_separates_paragraphs() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"one\", \"\", \"two\"])\n    assert paragraph_contents(root) == [\"one\", \"two\"]\n\n\ndef test_repeated_blank_lines_separate_paragraphs_without_extra_blocks() -> None:\n    root = False]\n\n\ndef test_document_root_is_a_container_with_no_content() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"a\"])\n    assert root.kind is DOCUMENT\n    assert root.content == \"\"\n\n\ndef test_default_registry_start_rules_are_the_thematic_break_atx_heading_indented_fenced_html_and_block_quote() -> None:\n    assert blocks.DEFAULT_REGISTRY.starts() == (\n        blocks.THEMATIC_BREAK,\n        blocks.ATX_HEADING,\n        blocks.INDENTED_CODE,\n        blocks.FENCED_CODE,\n        blocks.HTML_BLOCK,\n        blocks.BLOCK_QUOTE,\n    )\n\n\ndef test_lazy_block_type_must_accept_lines() -> None:\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        BlockType(\"bad\", continues=lambda block, cursor: True, lazy=True)\n\n\ndef test_leaf_block_type_must_have_an_add_line_rule() -> None:\n    with pytest.raises(ValueError):\n        BlockType(\"bad\", continues=lambda block, cursor: True, accepts_lines=True)\n\n\n# --- Extensibility: block types registered without changing the loop ---\n\n\ndef _rule_start(cursor: Cursor, container: Block) -> Block | None:\n    if cursor.rest.strip(\" \\t\") == \"***\":\n        cursor.advance_to(len(cursor.line))\n        return Block(RULE)\n    return None\n\n\nRULE = BlockType(\"rule\", continues=lambda block, cursor: False, start=_rule_start)\n\n\ndef test_registered_start_rule_interrupts_a_paragraph() -> None:\n    registry = BlockRegistry(root=DOCUMENT, fallback=PARAGRAPH)\n    registry.register(RULE)\n    root = parse_lines([\"a\", \"***\", \"b\"], registry)\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"paragraph\", \"rule\", \"paragraph\"]\n    assert paragraph_contents(root) == [\"a\", \"b\"]\n\n\ndef test_registered_start_rule_closes_an_unmatched_block_before_it_starts() -> None:\n    registry = BlockRegistry(root=DOCUMENT, fallback=PARAGRAPH)\n    registry.register(RULE)\n    root = parse_lines([\"***\", \"b\"], registry)\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"rule\", \"paragraph\"]\n    assert root.children[0].is_open is False\n\n\ndef _raw_start(cursor: Cursor, container: Block) -> Block | None:\n    if cursor.rest.startswith(\"<<\"):\n        cursor.advance_to(len(cursor.line))\n        return Block(RAW)\n    return None\n\n\nRAW = BlockType(\n    \"raw\",\n    continues=lambda block, cursor: True,\n    accepts_lines=True,\n    add_line=lambda block, cursor: block.lines.append(cursor.rest),\n    start=_raw_start,\n)\n\n\ndef test_start_rule_is_not_tried_inside_a_non_interruptible_leaf() -> None:\n    registry = BlockRegistry(root=DOCUMENT, fallback=PARAGRAPH)\n    registry.register(RAW)\n    registry.register(RULE)\n    root = parse_lines([\"<<\", \"***\"], registry)\n    assert kinds(root) == [\"raw\"]\n    assert root.children[0].lines[-1] == \"***\"\n\n\n# --- Lazy paragraph continuation, via a test-only container ---\n\n\ndef _quote_continues(block: Block, cursor: Cursor) -> bool:\n    index = cursor.next_nonspace()\n    if cursor.line[index : index + 1] == \">\":\n        cursor.advance_to(index + 1)\n        return True\n    return False\n\n\ndef _quote_start(cursor: Cursor, container: None\n\n\nQUOTE = BlockType(\"quote\", continues=_quote_continues, is_container=True, start=_quote_start)\n\n\ndef quote_registry() -> BlockRegistry:\n    registry = BlockRegistry(root=DOCUMENT, fallback=PARAGRAPH)\n    registry.register(QUOTE)\n    return registry\n\n\ndef test_quote_holds_its_paragraph() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"> a\", \"> b\"], quote_registry())\n    assert paragraph_contents(root.children[0]) == [\"a\\nb\"]\n\n\ndef test_blank_line_ends_the_lazy_continuation() -> None:\n    root = parse_lines([\"> a\", \"\", \"b\"], quote_registry())\n    assert
